page: local platform workbench from isolated AtomS3R worktree
firmware: Internal source-built ESP-IDF 5.5.1 AtomS3R protocol fixture; not factory firmware

checks.result: AtomS3R has no unavailable suffix; official v0.3 defaults first and trial-run button is present. Other S3R variants retain unavailable suffix. Factory binary not executed.
UI accepts flasher_args.json, bootloader, partition table and app; actual worker starts.
Pressed and held screen until guest emitted ATOMS3R_BUTTON 0 / ATOMS3R_BACKLIGHT 0; release produced ATOMS3R_BUTTON 1.
Held A until guest emitted ATOMS3R_BUTTON 0 / ATOMS3R_BACKLIGHT 128; release produced ATOMS3R_BUTTON 1.
Pressed and held screen until guest emitted ATOMS3R_BUTTON 0 / ATOMS3R_BACKLIGHT 255; release produced ATOMS3R_BUTTON 1.
Screen data-hover=button (green), white shell data-hover=orbit (blue); screen is a press button, not touch input.
128x128 final RGBA SHA256 matches real worker probe exactly; 3D and 2D display the same firmware pixels.
Runtime paused; task-owned browser closed and session list verified closed.

limits: No physical hardware validation or fresh 1:1 photo acceptance. Original geometric/photographic limitations retained.
Fast combined down/up helper calls did not produce guest button edges; separate held input plus observed serial was required. No host duration timing guarantee is claimed.
Initial Python HTTP default queue produced connection resets on module requests; a 128-entry queue served the unchanged app successfully.
